mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days during monetary easing cycles.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25% over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.2 percentage points over three months signals labor market deterioration, which typically precedes economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.2pp over three months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 0.1% in the prior month indicates robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS and HOUST both rise > 0.1% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS and HOUST both rise > 0.1% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply-constrained regime (industrial production below its 12-month moving average), a monthly increase in industrial production exceeding 0.5% signals supply recovery, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO rises > 0.5% in 1 month and INDPRO is below its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year inflation exceeds 3.5%, the Federal Reserve is likely to maintain or tighten monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY change > 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in payroll employment exceeding 0.5% signals a strong labor market, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS increases by at least 0.5% over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous tightening of monetary policy (FEDFUNDS rising) and a strengthening labor market (UNRATE falling) signals late-cycle monetary tightening, which typically precedes economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25% and UNRATE falls > 0.1pp in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25% and UNRATE falls > 0.1pp in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: In a high consumer demand regime (retail sales above 12-month average), a monthly increase in retail sales exceeding 0.2% signals sustained consumer strength, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS rises > 0.2% in 1 month and RSAFS is above its 12-month moving average.
